title: Korda - The Thinking Tackle Podcast
author: Korda Developments Ltd
description: Rich Stewart presents The Thinking Tackle Podcast. The original Thinking Tackle was one of Korda's most successful and popular projects ever, and now you can listen to it on the go. We will be speaking to a variety of popular guests, discussing advice and tips and sharing our most entertaining fishing stories and adventures. For more information and content from Rich Stewart visit, https://www.cypography.co.uk/.
